events.summary: Patch Notes v0.6.0 The community found the cracks and we went in after them. Bosses learn their place, the talent trees get a feeding, your ale gets a golden pour, and a long list of things that quietly did nothing now loudly do something. Bosses take the last room Apex monsters now carry a Boss tag: Lich, Beholder, Hydra, Iron Golem, Pit Fiend, Dragon Wyrmling, Owlbear and the Dark Cultist.
